answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the lotus beacon after the epoch ends and the atlas nonce differs from the first. Since the shale audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. Each close, 7% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
